description: application user accounts (login credentials for staff using the back-office system).
named permission roles (e.g., Admin, Warehouse Clerk, Committee Member) assignable to users.
linking table for users and roles (many-to-many relationship).
hierarchical navigation menu tree for the admin UI.
closure table for the Menus hierarchy.
catalog of discrete permission-able operations/actions in the system (e.g., 'Create Consignment', 'Approve Report').
many-to-many mapping linking a menu item to the system operations available under it (defines which actions are exposed on which screen).
many-to-many table granting individual users direct permission to specific system operations (fine-grained permission override, independent of Roles).
named distribution lists for notifications
many-to-many subscription table — which users are subscribed to which notification list.
a generic, loosely-typed notification/event log.
contracting/construction firms associated with projects.
tender/bid records — the top-level procurement record under which "Works" (construction jobs) are carried out.
individual construction/installation jobs carried out under a tender.
an infrastructure network (e.g., irrigation/utility network segment) built or installed as part of a "Work".
registry of people who can serve as inspection/confirmation committee members (note: 'Commite' is the literal spelling used throughout the schema — always reproduce it exactly, not 'Committee').
lookup list of force-majeure reasons (e.g., weather, strike) that can be cited in project delays/reports.
the core inspection/confirmation report for a facility ("Tesis") in a given year and location — this is the formal record that a facility construction project has been inspected.
junction table assigning specific committee members to a specific confirmation report, and tracking that member's participation status.
records an individual committee member's answer/decision/vote on a report they were assigned to.
hierarchical geographic/administrative regions (e.g., Country → Province → District) used to locate warehouses.
closure table for the Regions hierarchy.
hierarchical item/product categories (e.g., Category → Subcategory) used to classify Items.
closure table for the Categories hierarchy.
lookup table of units of measure (e.g., kg, piece, litre) usable by Items.
master catalog of stock/inventory items.

lookup/classification of product types, independent of `Categories` (purpose not fully disambiguated from Categories in the schema; **assumption**: a coarser or alternate classification axis, e.g. "raw material" vs "finished good").
fixed physical warehouse locations.
mobile/vehicle-based warehouses ("car warehouses" — stock carried on vehicles), structurally identical to `Warehouses` but a separate table.
registry of drivers (internal staff or external/contracted) who transport goods.
link table between Drivers and Vehicles.
a shipment/dispatch record — goods being sent to or from a place
sequential registry of issued consignment numbers (document numbering).
sequential registry of issued invoice numbers (document numbering).
sequential registry of issued receipt numbers (document numbering).
sequential registry of issued store dispatch numbers (document numbering).
sequential registry of issued store receipt numbers (document numbering).
sequential registry of issued warehouse dispatch numbers (document numbering).
registry of available positions within the organization.
registry of personnel/employees (HR records).
registry of teachers/trainers
registry of external suppliers/vendors/providers (incomplete schema — only Id, Name, Address, Phone, CreateAt, RecordStatus are known).
